मुख्यपृष्ठ / About Us

About Us

Lokhit Maharashtra is an independent Marathi-language digital news and public-information portal serving readers across Maharashtra.

Our Mission

We aim to make news about rural life, farming, water, drought, employment, public services and government schemes accessible and understandable. Our coverage includes news reports, explainers, and public-interest analysis.

Editorial Independence

We distinguish reporting from opinion, seek verifiable evidence, and correct significant errors when brought to our attention. Paid or sponsored content should be clearly identified.

Not a Government Website

Lokhit Maharashtra is not an official website of any government department. Verify scheme eligibility, deadlines and official orders with the relevant government authority.

Privacy Policy

This policy explains the information processed when you visit Lokhit Maharashtra. Last updated: 1 November 2026.

Information We Process

This static website currently does not offer public reader accounts or a comment system. The hosting provider may process standard request logs, including IP address, browser details and access times.

Third-Party Services

Google Fonts may serve web fonts. YouTube embeds can connect to Google's services when activated. Using social sharing links opens third-party websites governed by their own policies.

Administration and Credentials

Authorised editorial users interact with the GitHub API to publish content. Access credentials must not be submitted in comments, public posts or shared links. A GitHub access token is used in the browser only for authorised GitHub API requests and is not intentionally stored on our hosting server.

Cookies and Analytics

No first-party advertising or behavioural tracking system is currently configured in this static project. Third-party embedded services may use their own storage and cookies. This policy must be reviewed if advertising, analytics, registration or forms are added.

Contact and Changes

For privacy questions, use the official contact details once published. We may update this policy as services and legal requirements change.

entry.title: व्हिडिओ बातम्या
entry.content:
BREAKING NEWS
◆शरद पवार शेतकऱ्यांच्या बांधावर, तुळशी गावात भेट; 50 लाखांची मदतही दिली, दुष्काळ परिस्थितीबाबत मोदींना सांगणार◆शेतमजुरांसाठी रोजगार हमीची माहिती गावात पोहोचणे का आवश्यक?◆दुष्काळात महिला बचतगटांची भूमिका : माहिती, रोजगार आणि आधार◆टँकर मागणीपासून तक्रारीपर्यंत : ग्रामपंचायतीने कोणती माहिती ठेवावी?◆रब्बी पेरणीपूर्वी पाण्याचा हिशेब करा : दुष्काळात निर्णय कसा घ्यावा?◆ठिबक सिंचन आणि पाणी बचत : मर्यादित पाण्यातील शेतीसाठी पर्याय◆गावातील जलसंधारण : उन्हाळ्याआधी कोणती कामे परिणामकारक ठरू शकतात?◆कर्जमाफी, कर्जपुनर्गठन आणि हप्त्यांना मुदतवाढ : फरक नेमका काय?
